name: MR. PRATT'S TWO DOLLARS AND SIXTY CENTS
note: Named by docs/111-scenes-b-and-c.md (THE SALE) and read by tools/extract-content.mjs (errata 237). Pratt's price for the raccoon, counted out at THE SALE; spent at the undertaker's exactly as SHENG'S LOAN was (doc 57 E3.3). Doc 111 writes it one LOOK and one LISTEN.

LOOK_AT.say: Two dollars and sixty cents, counted out coin by coin. The exact cost of my funeral, paid for with a raccoon.

LISTEN_TO.say: Quiet. Mr. Pratt's money has never had much to say.
